sections.title: List players handler
sections.what: Returns the player list sorted by team, and returns an empty list with status 500 if the database read fails.
sections.why: Likely reason: the team builder can keep working with an empty list rather than breaking.
sections.watch_out: The player list has no sign-in check, so anyone who can reach the address can read it.

summary: Returns the list of players for the fantasy team builder, sorted by team.
purpose: Gives the team builder the players to choose from.
why: Reason not stated in the code beyond supplying a player list.
how: 1) Reads every player's id, name, team, role and credits from the database, sorted by team. 2) Returns them as JSON. 3) On any error, returns an empty list with a 500 status.
inputs: The player table in the database.
outputs: A JSON list of players, or an empty list with status 500.
risks: Errors are hidden, so a database fault looks the same as no players.
debug: If the builder shows no players, check the database connection and then the player table. The error itself is not logged here.
